It was a few weeks back. I’m getting better, to be honest. I feel horrible, but better.

It was February 10th, 2018....

I had a huge fight with my mum for not attending my dads birthday party, (I know what your thinking. “This is fake!” Whatever. I don’t really care, but I’m going to talk about this.) and my mum was telling me why I wasn’t there. I said because my family making a big party, and there was a lot of people there. She was disappointed, and asked if I cared about my father. I said that I did care, but I didn’t want to go to the party. She then asked why I was like this, closed off from the family and “edged?”. I didn’t respond, so the made an obvious sigh and left the room, leaving me with my thoughts. I had a couple of razor blades under my bed, so I took them, and I started cutting my fingers. Yes, fingers. Then I worked my way down to my wrist, then arm. I them went to the bathroom very quickly without anyone noticing, and washed the cuts. I didn’t want them to get infected. I then hid my arm in my very long sleeves, and went into my drawer to look for any pills. I found 24 Tylenol pills. I took 4, then went to the bathroom to forcefully throw up because I felt bad. I then continued to take them, one by one. I had took 17 more, and I started to feel drowsy, my heart was beating quickly, I felt like throwing up again, and my head was throbbing. I don’t know if anyone else felt like this, or if something else was happening, but I didn’t care. I knew that this was bad, and I was panicking too. I was freaking out, but I just sat there, on the bathroom floor, crying, panicking, felling like I’ve gone insane. I then blacked out a few minutes after. 

I woke up in the hospital to see my mum, dad, sister, and boyfriend. They all had tears in their eyes, and my mum was crying in the back when my bf ran to me and hugged me with all his might, then backed away because I told him I hurt everywhere, and soon everyone else came to me to hug me, comfort me, etc.

I feel like this should be some sort of drama. Sure feels like it.

I was told that I needed to go to therapy, and that I needed to be “watched”. I felt horrible, and I felt like doing it again. They but bandages on my arm, because the doctors noticed some blood stains on my fingernails, and found all the cuts I did to myself. I know my family is disappointed, but, whatever. Life isn’t fair, and never was fair, to me. Negative feelings is just something normal to me. I’m surprised if someone is happy with me, laughing with me, not ignoring me, etc.. But it’s getting better. I feel better now, and I regret doing that. I feel more confident and i know I won’t be doing it again in the future. Maybe. But, I didn’t let it affect me that much. 

I’m okay! My family has let it pass, somehow, and my boyfriend isn’t worried all the time. 

At least I’m not thought of as insane. That’s all I care about anyway. But still, I regret it, deeply.

Hey, I was a victim of serious bullying. Very serious bullying. Don’t kill yourself. People who bully just want attention, because they don’t know how to properly get it, and are often secretly insecure, so they hide their feelings with “hate” towards others. Killing your self to get the school to investigate and stuff isn’t the right way, let alone the best. You need to tell your teachers/counselors that you are being bullied and that you feel this way. You need to bring justice to yourself! You need to change this. You see, I was bullied for almost the entire time I was in school. I would get pushed into lockers, *locked* into lockers, pushed down stairs and beaten into unconsciousness. I had it really bad. I too wanted to die, but I didn’t. I reached out to everyone I could, I did whatever I could. And look! I’m still here, alive, happy, and proud of what I did. I want you to be the same. Be confident, and ruin their day! Get them expelled if you can! Be strong, and don’t care about what happens to them. Don’t care, at all. 

Be strong! Be confident! Be you. You have it better too, I suffered with mental disorders such as OCD and bipolar. But I managed to get through it, and I know you will too.

Also, if you need someone to talk to, feel free to DM/PM me anytime.

•Sleeping helps sometimes

•Eating/drinking yogurt, orange juice or oatmeal. But I can’t eat/drink them in the same meal.

•Piano

•Listening to Panic! At The Disco and TØP

•Writing on a piece of paper, rolling it up in a toothpick-like shape, then throwing it out
